fact: Article 201 of the Code du numérique makes storage and hosting of personal data in the DRC the default, with export a derogation needing the data protection authority's authorisation; the Code entered into force on 13 March 2023 and the ARPTC exercises the authority's functions in the interim, having issued Decision 039/ARPTC/CLG/2025 of 11 September 2025.
title: The Code du numérique is an architecture decision
